description: A sailboat composed of key components such as a mast, sails, rudder, hull shape, and deck to ensure easy recognition.

drawing_instructions.composition: The sailboat will be composed with several key components clearly delineated to ensure easy recognition. The main sail will be positioned horizontally across the center of the composition, with a mast extending upwards from the boat's structure. A smaller auxiliary sail will be placed near the bow for balance and stability. Two masts will be visible on either side of the main mast, each with their own set of sails. A rudder will be positioned at the stern to help steer the boat, and the hull shape will define the boat’s form. The composition will include details such as the deck, rails, and possibly a figurehead for added aesthetic appeal.
drawing_instructions.intent: Plan an original line drawing of a sailboat, identifying its distinguishing visible components and how they relate spatially. Plan a clear composition so a viewer can recognize the subject without a label.
